Marked 16.4.2, vendored from the published npm package's `lib/marked.esm.js`.
Source: https://github.com/markedjs/marked/tree/v16.4.2
License: MIT, reproduced in `marked-LICENSE.md`.

Served locally so Markdown previews need no CDN or runtime package installation.
The review renderer escapes raw HTML, restricts outgoing links and displays image
descriptions without loading remote content.
